originalTitle: New Doomsday Trailer + Ghost Rider + Black Panther Recast! Marvel Comic Con Panel Breakdown!
content: Here’s our complete breakdown of the Marvel Hall H Panel at SDCC 2026! David Jonsson is the new Black Panther in Black Panther 3 coming Dec 15 2028! Ryan Gosling is Ghost Rider, also coming in 2028 from a movie directed by Shawn Levy! Denim Deadpool crashed the party for Avengers Doomsday and we got a new Doomsday trailer! Erik Voss breaks down everything we learned and saw at Marvel Studios’ Hall H panel at San Diego Comic-Con 2026!
